data.one_liner: Manage your network layer with dio, offering dynamic model parsing, caching, and refresh tokens.
data.what_it_does: Vexana simplifies network operations built on top of Dio. It provides dynamic model parsing, base error models, request cancellation, file uploads and downloads, token refresh handling, and response caching.
use_when: You want a structured network layer built on top of Dio with built-in model parsing.
You need automated refresh token handling and request locking on auth failures.
You require response caching with file or shared preferences backing.
avoid_when: You prefer writing raw Dio code without wrapper classes or specific interfaces.
You use a fully generated networking client framework like Retrofit.
strengths: Built-in token refresh mechanism that locks requests until tokens renew.
Built-in caching support with File and Shared Preferences options.
Structured result types using sealed classes via sendRequest.
weaknesses: Requires wrapping response models with INetworkModel.
Tied specifically to the Dio client library.
data.setup_notes: Configure BaseOptions and NetworkManager with your base URL and optional error models.
